title: Quarterly Mosaic: signal-driven commit windows and rollout lanes for Hosted API model catalog
creator: Marco Li
description: Goal: Define and validate a quarterly planning pattern that ties model-catalog commits to measurable 'signals' (latency, cost-per-token, quality regression) and organizes work into explicit rollout lanes (fast-canary, staged, experimental) for the Hosted API. Scope: - Define commit window cadence and signal thresholds for model swaps and variant promotions. - Create templated rollout lanes (fast-canary, slow-graded, experimental dark-launch) with clear gating steps and rollback rules. - Map quarterly OKRs to commit windows and staffing slots so we can guarantee runway and on-call coverage during high-risk rotations. - Deliver a lightweight orchestration checklist and a readiness dashboard for PM/Eng/Design. Out of scope: Dedicated/Private-specific infra changes (those will be handled by separate ENG epics). Success criteria: operationalized commit windows used for at least two model rotations this quarter and a reduction in emergency rollback incidents during those rotations.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A documented commit window calendar for Q2 that ties to team staffing and capacity reservations
A2: Signal definitions (numeric thresholds) for latency, p99 error rate, embedding drift, and cost-per-token with owners assigned
A3: Three templated rollout lanes published in Confluence with explicit gates and rollback playbooks
A4: A lightweight readiness dashboard (can be a Grafana dashboard or Console route) showing signals and a green/yellow/red status per model variant
A5: Pilot: at least one hosted-model swap uses the new commit window + rollout lane and completes without a Sev-1 or customer-facing incident
progress_updates: 2026-03-01: Ticket created; kickoff with Eng reliability and Observability to align on signal candidates.
2026-03-04: Draft signal set proposed: latency p95>target+20%, p99 > target+30%, token cost delta >15%, eval prompt set regression >3% absolute. Shared with Research for feedback.
2026-03-07: Design reviewed rollout lane UX for Console; identified need for a per-route toggle to opt into experimental lane. Assigned ENG-31522 to implement toggle API.
2026-03-10: PM/Eng sync: agreed to a 2-week commit window cadence with two staffed windows per month. Iterate dashboard prototype next week. Added dark-launch lane to experiment list.
2026-03-10: Risks logged: capacity contention during overlapping commit windows; mitigation: reserve small burst pool and limit concurrent host swaps to 2.
decision_log: 2026-03-04: Chose numeric thresholds for signals as a first iteration; will refine with two live rotations.
2026-03-07: Opted to keep Dedicated/Private out of scope to accelerate pilot on Hosted API.
2026-03-10: Agreed 2-week commit windows to balance agility and coordination costs.
2026-03-10: Decided to reserve a 10% burst pool for commit window operations to reduce capacity contention.
